description: 异色格象 — 白方胜：黑象无法守住升变格

intro.popup_en: A key opposite-colored-bishop position: the white pawn is heading for a8, a light square protected by the white bishop. The black bishop is dark-squared and can never stop promotion.
intro.popup:
⚠️ 异色格象关键局
白兵奔向a8（浅色格），白象守护浅色格。
黑象只能走深色格——永远无法阻挡升变！

outro.popup_en: White wins. The key is Kf3 on move two: it cuts off the black bishop's route back through e2, so the bishop cannot return in time.
outro.popup: ✅ 白方获胜！关键在第2步：白王走f3切断黑象的退路，令黑象无法及时回防。

moves.popup_en: The black bishop goes on the attack and looks for a way to interfere.
moves.popup: 黑象主动出击，寻找干扰机会。

moves.popup_en: Key move: Kf3 cuts off the black bishop's route back through e2.
moves.popup: ⚡ 关键！白王走f3，封锁黑象经由e2返回的通道。

moves.popup_en: The bishop changes route, but it can no longer catch the pawn in time.
moves.popup: 黑象换路，但已很难追上白兵。

moves.popup_en: The pawn advances to the seventh rank. Promotion is imminent.
moves.popup: ♟ 白兵推进到第7格，升变在即！

moves.popup_en: The black bishop makes one last attempt to intercept the pawn.
moves.popup: 黑象最后一搏，试图拦截白兵。

moves.popup_en: The pawn promotes. The dark-squared bishop cannot stop it from reaching the light square a8.
moves.popup: 🎉 升变！黑象是暗格象，a8是浅色格，无法阻止。

moves.popup_en: The black bishop gives check in a final attempt to resist.
The white queen captures the bishop with check. The result is decided.
moves.popup: 白后吃象并将军，大势已定。

moves.popup_en: The black king captures the queen, but White has an easy winning king-and-pawn ending.
moves.popup: 黑王吃后，剩白方轻松胜。
